Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick chat earlier. Per our conversation, attached is a compact SOW that flips the package a bit — SummitSphere would like to offer Redwood a co-hosted 90-minute hands-on workshop ("atelier") in exchange for upgrading our 30-minute breakout to a co-hosted format and expanded brand visibility.

High-level what we're proposing:
- Workshop: 90-minute co-branded, hands-on lab for up to 40 attendees; two Redwood speakers + one SummitSphere facilitator.
- Breakout swap: your existing 30-min breakout becomes a "co-hosted" 45-min session with 10 mins expanded Q&A and priority placement in the attendee agenda.
- Visibility: premium logo placement on workshop signage, inclusion in the partner lounge welcome banner, and one dedicated shout-out during opening remarks.
- Lead capture: real-time badge-scan data + a consolidated CSV delivered 48 hours post-event.
- Recording: SummitSphere records all sessions; partner may request recording with standard sharing terms (outlined in SOW).

Attachments: SummitSphere_SOW_v1.pdf (draft).

We can sign this as an amendment to the existing sponsorship package if the above looks reasonable. Happy to route to DocuSign once we align on a couple of items: guaranteed headcount, rehearsal slot, and any exclusivity asks.

Would you be able to confirm by EOD Friday (10/16)? If not, we can bump.

Cheers,
Sanjay
Director, Strategic Partnerships
SummitSphere Events

Sanjay — thanks, appreciate the clear SOW. A few quick clarifications and asks from Redwood before we pull in legal/DocuSign:

1) Headcount guarantee: we need a minimum room capacity of 40 reserved seats with a dropdown to 50 if registration exceeds expectation (we'll confirm actual signups two weeks out). Please confirm the room (room B7 is acceptable).
2) AV/setup: the workshop requires a table for demo machines (4 laptops + 2 GPUs), HDMI + local network + a rehearsal slot day-before (30 mins). Can you confirm there will be a dedicated tech contact onsite?
3) Lead data & privacy: CSV with badge-scans OK, but we need name, company, email, and opt-in status. Delivery within 48 hours is fine; Redwood legal requests a one-paragraph consent notice be included at registration.
4) Recording rights: Redwood must be able to reuse the recording for product marketing (trimmed excerpts) — we'd need explicit permission in the SOW for that.
5) Exclusivity/no-compete: we decline blanket category exclusivity for the partner lounge. We are fine with a single "AI platform" partner mention in the opening, but not exclusivity.
6) Financial/credits: Given the swap, we'd expect a 15% exhibitor fee credit applied to our package or two comp conference passes for additional engineers to staff the workshop.

If you can accept the above, please mark the SOW and route to DocuSign. I will loop Legal if there are redlines.

Thanks — I'll also copy Tessa (events ops) for logistics and Logan for speaker alignment.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
